components.name: agentide-engine
components.summary: Validates intents, plans effects, obtains authority, journals, dispatches, and projects sessions.

errors.name: agentide.coding.IntentFailure
errors.summary: The intent was refused or failed without claiming the requested effect happened.

errors.name: agentide.session.SessionRefusal
errors.summary: The session operation was not admitted or could not be observed exactly.

errors.name: agentide.session.SessionStateConflict
errors.summary: The session is not in a state this command acts from.

errors.name: agentide.surface.SurfaceFailure
errors.summary: The requested virtual-surface transition was refused or could not be projected.

semantic_catalog.summary: A coding-session interface in which agents invoke stable semantic intents while deployments bind those intents to guarded implementations and humans observe the same durable event projection.

served.contract: a query answering `agentide.session.SessionSnapshot` with rows projected from `agentide.session.CodingSession` at `read_your_writes` consistency
served.why: how the projection is kept current is a storage decision

served.contract: a query answering `agentide.surface.WorkbenchSnapshot` with rows projected from `agentide.surface.Workbench` at `read_your_writes` consistency
served.why: how the projection is kept current is a storage decision

scopes.description: Optional conjunctive visibility scopes; an empty object is private to the owner.
